name: air bike

phases.label: Right elbow toward left knee; right leg extends
Left elbow toward right knee; left leg extends

source_instructions: Lie flat on your back with your hands placed behind your head.
Lift your legs off the ground and bend your knees at a 90-degree angle.
Bring your right elbow towards your left knee while simultaneously straightening your right leg.
Return to the starting position and repeat the movement on the opposite side, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee while straightening your left leg.
Continue alternating sides in a pedaling motion for the desired number of repetitions.
interpretation: One controlled alternating supine bicycle crunch. Raised legs start with knees90degrees. Separate relaxed palms remain behind the head; the active elbow approaches the opposite knee while the other leg straightens. Pelvis remains supported and both feet stay airborne. The natural lumbar arch is retained. Five-second pace is authored; source specifies desired repetitions.

explicit_staging.hands: Separate palms cradle the occiput with gently articulated fingers; source palm plane is measured from original geometry. No neck pull.
explicit_staging.wrists: 35degree palm/forearm deviation is an authored staging bound, not a clinical range.
explicit_staging.back: Posterior pelvic skin is supported; lumbar gap is measured without claiming whole-lumbar contact.
explicit_staging.timing: Opposite peaks at1.25/3.75seconds; one complete5second alternating cycle.

hip flexors.mapping: Visible sartorius and limited deep iliopsoas surface projection; not exposed iliopsoas tissue.

artistic_emphasis: Stable soft warm main/additional zones; neutral inactive body. No phase-dependent physiological recruitment claim.

correctives.method: Three state keys: exact native original-cage local joint smoothing mapped by inverse unit DQ rotation, plus one smoothly feathered posterior flank pocket per key. No global smoothing, helper, weight or Basis edit.

source_gaps.timing: Desired repetitions, no speed; one5second cycle authored.
source_gaps.hand_detail: Hands behind head is sourced; separate palm placement/finger curl authored.
source_gaps.other_joint_angles: Only starting90degree knees are sourced; remaining angles are illustration targets, not validated clinical ranges.
